arena_deepseek_v4_pro.note: Redo of the external-frontier-reference leg using deepseek-v4-pro (GA 2026-08-13, 1.6T/49B-active-param reasoning tier) instead of deepseek-v4-flash (284B/13B-active), at the user's request. Found and fixed a new bug first: v4-pro's reasoning routinely ran 1100-2750 tokens on this one-sentence task, blowing through the 800-token budget sized for v4-flash (finish_reason=length, empty content, 40/45 gated out); raised to a flat 4500 and got 40/45 usable (vs. flash's 27/45). Also fixed a latent JsonlCache bug before it could bite: the DeepSeek reference cache was keyed on (anchor, scenario) only, so switching --deepseek-model without adding 'model' to the key would have silently replayed flash's cached answers under the pro label. All 82 comparisons here (42 vs_bon, 40 vs_deepseek) are freshly regenerated and freshly judged -- vs_bon numbers differ slightly from the deepseek_flash run above (91%/53%/100% vs. 64%/53%/94%) purely from RNG-reshuffled Candidate positions plus ordinary judge-to-judge variance on borderline pairs (same underlying fused/BoN sentence pairs both times) -- not a new finding, just noise on an already-decisive comparison. The vs_deepseek numbers ARE the new finding.
